text.p: *Australian bond futures finished after hours trading little changed from Wednesday's dayside session after a further probe to the downside lacked follow through.
*A break of support at 92.880 on the 10-year bond contract proves brief, but the market now needs to overcome 92.950.
Australian bond futures contracts finished after hours trading little changed from Wednesday's dayside session after a further probe to the downside lacked follow-through.
The September 10-year bond futures contract ended SYCOM at 92.900 compared with a pit close of 92.885 and after hitting 92.845 at one stage.

The break of support at 92.880 on the 10-year bond contract proved brief, but the market is now looking vulnerable after breaching this month's steep rising trendline and will need to overcome 92.905 to put the rally back on course, analysts said.
The market also needs to take out 92.950 before it can seriously consider a challenge of Monday's 3-1/4 year high of 93.090 set by the now expired June contract.

A rebound in U.S. Treasuries on Wednesday helped to stabilise local contracts, but moves to the upside are likely to be struggle in the absence of key domestic data over the next couple of weeks, analysts added.
